identity.positioning: Serious, high-trust, secure, bilingual (Arabic default + English) logistics tech platform connecting shippers, drivers, fleet providers, and enterprise logistics in Oman and the GCC.
identity.design_tone: Enterprise technology, restrained elegance, zero slop, high visual density, high readability, tactical clarity.

primary.description: Deep Slate Navy Blue from the official CARGO wordmark & C-mark container. Used for primary headers, navigation bars, main action buttons, active navigation states, and hero sections.

accent.description: Vibrant Motion Orange from the logo's three speed bars inside the C mark. Used for key CTAs, highlights, interactive map pickup/dropoff focal pins, active status tags, and primary action accents.

arabic.usage: Primary font when language is Arabic (default).

english.usage: Primary font when language is English.

mono.usage: Used for Tracking IDs, License Plate Numbers, Oman CR Numbers, and API/Audit data.

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-[#16233A]
hierarchy.caption: text-xs text-[#94A3B8] font-medium

bilingual_rtl_ltr_strategy.direction_attribute: dir='rtl' for Arabic, dir='ltr' for English
layout_rules: Use Tailwind logical utilities: ms-* (margin-start), me-* (margin-end), ps-* (padding-start), pe-* (padding-end) instead of ml/mr/pl/pr.
Icons indicating forward motion (e.g. ChevronRight, ArrowRight, Truck) MUST flip horizontally in RTL mode using 'rtl:rotate-180' or 'rtl:-scale-x-100'.
Route display (From -> To): In Arabic (RTL), origin is on the right, arrow points to the left (من -> إلى). In English (LTR), origin is on left, arrow points right.
Table headers and alignment: text-right for RTL Arabic, text-left for LTR English.
Phone number inputs (+968 XXXXXXXX) must keep LTR direction explicitly (dir='ltr') for standard digit ordering even in Arabic mode.

public_landing.header: Sticky navbar with CARGO logo, language switcher (AR/EN), portal quick links, Login modal trigger button.
public_landing.hero: Bold dark navy backdrop with subtle geometric grid overlay, high-impact headline, Dual CTA (Create Shipment / Join as Driver), live stats strip (Shipments Completed, Active Drivers in Oman, Avg Response Time).
public_landing.sections: How It Works (3-step visual cards), Core Services (Land Freight, Container Trucking, Flatbed & Heavy Haul, Express Cargo), Fleet Types, Oman Coverage Map, Testimonials, Contact & Support.

customer_portal.sidebar_nav: Home/Dashboard, My Shipments, Create Shipment, Saved Locations, Notifications, Profile & Security.
customer_portal.key_feature: Create Shipment Wizard with interactive map location selection, automatic route distance calculation, and instant bid comparison grid.

driver_portal.sidebar_nav: Dashboard, Available Loads, My Bids, Active Trip, Trip History, Vehicle & License Documents, Profile.
driver_portal.key_feature: Mobile-optimized interface, large tap targets, high contrast load details, status progression button (Start Pickup -> Goods Loaded -> In Transit -> Arrived -> Delivered).

transport_provider_portal.sidebar_nav: Overview, Opportunities Board, Fleet Management, Drivers List, Active Trips, Revenue & Invoices.
transport_provider_portal.key_feature: Fleet assignment modal, multi-bid management, vehicle dispatching matrix.

admin_portal.sidebar_nav: Command Center, Driver & Provider Verification, All Shipments, Active Trips, User Management, Audit Logs, Settings.
admin_portal.key_feature: Density-focused data tables with filter drawer, quick approval/rejection drawer for driver licenses & Oman commercial registrations (CR).

universal_guidelines.data_testid_requirement: EVERY interactive element (buttons, tabs, form fields, modals, status updates, map pin selections, language switchers, table rows, action items) MUST include an explicit data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='create-shipment-btn', data-testid='lang-switcher-ar', data-testid='accept-bid-btn').
universal_guidelines.no_transparent_overlays: Never leave navigation headers or modal backgrounds purely transparent without a backdrop blur or solid white/navy container background.
universal_guidelines.strict_accessibility: Ensure all text on navy (#16233A) backgrounds uses pure white (#FFFFFF), and all text on light surfaces satisfies WCAG AA contrast (contrast ratio > 4.5:1).
